authority.actor_role: delivery actor; root or delegated independent grader computes and approves all scores.
authority.basis: Root instruction 2026-10-08 to freeze evaluation against the primary current incumbent before H230 candidate prediction.
authority.scope: Exposed fold-0 development comparison only; not a public score prediction and no promotion.

candidate.prediction_sha256: sealed in terminal export receipt after successful export

evaluation.exposure: Previously inspected fold0 development groups; not a fresh holdout.

literal_evaluation_mask.mask_rule: Only these 468 evaluation groups; inside each sequence official row mask is need_prediction AND is_scored from valid_targets row order; labels and predictions clipped to +/-2; original clipped-label magnitude weights.

predeclared_comparisons.primary: H230 candidate fixed epoch1 minus current primary incumbent endpoint on the exact same exposed 468 fold0 groups; incumbent primary endpoint is the fixed c20261004_combo_s4_i16 source tuple shown above, with FP32 source reference and actual i16 ZIP identity both bound.
predeclared_comparisons.reporting: Report official overall score and T0/T1 separately, paired delta and component bootstrap; do not add any local delta to 0.6660, infer public performance, or promote automatically.
predeclared_comparisons.secondary: H230 candidate minus the matched seed3 family-head-off control only after its terminal fit/export; exact recipe comparison remains separate and is not substituted for the incumbent comparison.

uncertainty.interpretation: Conditions on fixed models and exposed groups; does not include training variability or public-transfer uncertainty.
uncertainty.unit: connected components from frozen fold0 map

cached_fp32_source_reference.construction: 0.5 * parent@ep3 output + 0.5 * head@ep0 output. This is the float32 source-level equivalent of the exact merged-head package; package ZIP uses i16 precision, so the cached FP32 reference is not represented as bit-identical ZIP inference.
cached_fp32_source_reference.served_zip_i16_parity_note: The exact ZIP remains the primary serving artifact. Root may additionally replay its callback on the same 468 sequences; keep that result separate from the FP32 source-level reference.

primary_incumbent.identity: Current own public-best endpoint, c20261004_combo_s4_i16, user-reported portal score 0.6660.
